pick.headline: Soviet nuclear submarine Komsomolets sinks in the Norwegian Sea
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of April 10, 1989, carried Moscow TASS in English: a fire aboard a nuclear-powered submarine southwest of Bear Island, sinking at more than 1,500 metres, loss of life, and Yazov ruling out radioactive contamination.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, No. 067, 10 April 1989
evidence.snippet: FBIS-SOV-89-067 10 April 1989 Nuclear-Powered Submarine Sinks Off Norway Coast TASS Loess of Life LD0804080789 Moscow TASS in English 0800 GMT 8 Apr 8&9 [Text] Moscow April 8 TASS—A fire broke out on board a Soviet nuclear-powered torpedo submarine in the international water…

alternates.headline: United States breaks diplomatic relations with Iran
alternates.fbis: The South Asia Daily Report of April 8, 1980, listed Iran's Revolution Council meeting discussing the break with the U.S., its communique on relations, militants pleased with sanctions, and the effects of Carter's moves.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: South Asia, Vol. VIII No. 069, 8 April 1980
evidence.snippet: …eting Revolution Council Meeting Discusses Break With U.S. Security Measures Taken Purther Report on Meeting Council Communique on Relations Ahmad Khomeyni Meets With Students Militants Pleased With Sanctions Effects of Carter's Moves KEYHAN Names Hostage Accused of Seducing Girl [30 Mar] Relations With Iraq Reported, Discussed Embassy Staff Recalled Khomeyni Statement on Iraqi Demands Bani-Sadr's Comments on Iraq Qotbzadeh on Iraq Qotbzadeh…
